questions.question: Taxis leave every 15 minutes and buses every 20 minutes. They both leave at 6:00. When will they next leave together? Show your multiples.
questions.expected_answer: Multiples of 15: 15, 30, 45, 60. Multiples of 20: 20, 40, 60. The lowest common multiple is 60, so they next leave together 60 minutes later, at 7:00.

questions.question: Find the highest common factor of 84 and 120 and use it to split 84 altos and 120 sopranos into equal groups.
questions.expected_answer: The common factors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12, so the highest common factor is 12. There are 12 groups, each with 120 ÷ 12 = 10 sopranos and 84 ÷ 12 = 7 altos.

questions.question: Use a factor tree to write 60 as a product of prime factors.
questions.expected_answer: 60 splits into 6 and 10. 6 is 2 × 3 and 10 is 2 × 5. So 60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5, and the prime factors are 2, 3 and 5.
